historical_reviews.deepseek: Retains manual visual confirmation but conflates commanded indicator control with the activity-driven Access/Busy signal.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds safe stimulus/data boundary, idle-to-active timing, exact target identity, cleanup and recovery.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Present and Locate rows use insertion or explicit service commands; neither exercises the Access/Busy activity transition.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The literal source lacks an I/O stimulus, so the review preserves insertion and LED scope while requiring an approved read-only or isolated workload.

original_test_intent: Verify the approved NVMe SSD's physical Access/Busy LED follows the platform-defined idle and activity states without unexpected storage errors.
original_method: A qualified operator inserts and observes the mapped SSD while the agent runs one approved data-safe workload against the verified target and records complete I/O, health and log evidence.
manual_activity: Engineer resolves scope and approves LED/workload matrix; qualified operator inserts and observes idle/active states; agent runs only the approved isolated stimulus.
required_inputs: Decision on SAS/SATA identity versus literal NVMe Access/Busy scope
Platform idle/active LED state, cadence and timing specification
Read-only or isolated test-file workload with duration and cleanup
Supported insertion/data/RAID recovery, qualified operator, camera and OOB
safety_requirements: Prove target device and data boundary before any I/O
Exclude production, boot, mounted uncontrolled and unsafe array targets
Track the workload PID and stop on media, filesystem, RAID, thermal, power, BMC or mapping errors
Verify LED returns to idle and no worker remains
Do not use Locate/raw IPMI or write unspecified data
agent_execution_scope: Capture stable mapping, idle baseline, workload parameters and health
Start and stop only the approved target-specific stimulus
Correlate operator idle/active evidence with I/O timestamps
Do not handle hardware, invent LED semantics, touch unspecified data or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve scope and approve target/workload/LED matrix
Provide operator and own physical/data recovery
Review correlated evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Locate/raw indicator commands do not generate normal storage access and may control a different lamp; lsblk alone cannot prove Access/Busy behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run a bounded read-only or isolated test-file I/O against the stable mapped target, capture utilization and controller/OS evidence, then prove clean stop and return to idle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVMe insertion, Access/Busy observation, system-spec Criteria and source 15/8 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Measure a documented idle-active-idle sequence for one exact drive with timestamped operator and I/O evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Supplies the missing safe activity stimulus and cleanup proof without changing the target indicator.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation creates/records activity; physical visual confirmation remains manual.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Caching or controller aggregation may prevent a workload from reaching the physical drive and must be defined by the platform.

project_override_considerations: Project authority must resolve the SAS/SATA/NVMe taxonomy and define whether controller cache activity qualifies; no generic Locate command may be accepted as Access/Busy coverage.
expected_evidence: Scope decision and approved idle/active LED matrix
Operator insertion and idle-active-idle photos/video with timestamps
Exact workload command, target, PID, exit and cleanup
Final idle/healthy state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: SAS/SATA Test Set and Items conflict with the explicit NVMe target in Procedure; the authoritative hardware scope is unresolved, while Access/Busy remains the intended indicator.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Scope, LED timing, safe workload, mapping and operator are supplyable inputs; static review is complete and later cases may continue.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row114 Wistron-Storage-00097-V003: decide whether the authoritative target is NVMe Access/Busy despite SAS/SATA grouping, SAS/SATA Access/Busy, or separate variants; define idle/active/cadence/timing and return-to-idle behavior plus an approved read-only or isolated test-file stimulus, stable target map and recovery. Locate/raw IPMI must not substitute for activity.

review_improvement: Replaces semantically wrong Locate/raw commands with a bounded real-I/O transition and records the unresolved device-family scope.
independent_technical_reasoning: An activity LED must correlate with actual media or controller I/O, not with a service-identification command. Because cache can absorb requests and device names can drift, the workload must target a stable mapped volume while controller counters and operator video share timestamps; otherwise a blink cannot be attributed to the intended SSD.
